name: Mingyu Ding
school: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: IDEAL is a full-stack robot-learning lab. OHRA (RSS 2026) studies cross-hand policy representations, and Current as Touch learns compliant contact feedback from proprioception.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full OHRA methods execute learned grasp synthesis on Franka FR3 with LEAP variants and L515 depth; each of two zero-shot real-hand variants succeeds in71/100 trials. The headline81.9% and in-hand PPO reorientation concern simulation. Full Current-as-Touch executes learned motor-current-conditioned compliance on FR3/LEAP and G1/Dex3: cup stacking/wiping use learned assistance during human teleoperation; card picking and dynamic bottle holding use autonomous learned policies. Card pose relies on VICON at training/inference and bottle holding on a fixed precomputed pose. All-UNC papers plus the current IDEAL roster establish current directed work, including equal Ding/Szafir advising; visitor apparatus access is still unconfirmed.
